notes: Vortex Launcher 0.2.2 - installation-local libraries. Windows data stays beside Vortex Launcher.exe; macOS data stays in Vortex Launcher Data beside the installed .app, outside its signed bundle. New empty installation folders start clean; old global library pointers are ignored. IMPORTANT: old AppData/Application Support libraries and remembered sign-in are not automatically imported. Old files are preserved, not deleted or moved. Keep the same installation folder for future updates; keep the adjacent Mac Data folder. Includes unchanged Vortex Client 0.2.0 and 0.2.1 launch fixes. macOS beta is ad-hoc signed, not notarized; Open Anyway may be required.
